check(x: int) -> int fail Bad =
  ex check(4) == 4
  if x % 2 == 1
    fail Bad(n: x)
  x

all_even(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] fail Bad =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex all_even([2, 4]) == [2, 4]
  let ys = par for x in xs
    check(x: x)?
  ys

test_all_even() =
  assert all_even([2, 4]) == [2, 4]
